text_block_list.name: Riri
text_block_list.text: Ugh... It's so slippery, it's hard to move... At this rate, I won't be able to fight properly...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ……
そこら中ぬるぬるしていて、
動き辛いです……
このままでは、
まともに戦えません……

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: Lili, at times like this, let's think about it the other way around, okay? In fact, why don't we think about how it's okay to be slimy~
text_block_list.orig_text:
リリちゃん、
こーゆう時は逆に考えよ？
むしろ、
ぬるぬるべたべたしてもいいんだー
って
考えてみよっか～

text_block_list.name: Misora
text_block_list.text: I see... So, how do you plan to deal with this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほどー？
要は、
どー対策するかですね？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: Mmm. Even if it's hard to fight, it feels good when you're slimy, doesn't it? So I don't think it'll be okay♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ン～ン。
戦いづらくても、
ぬるぬるしたらキモチいいじゃん？
だから、
別によくねー
ってコト♪

text_block_list.name: Riri
text_block_list.text: I-Is that what you mean? I guess we'll just have to give it everything we've got!
text_block_list.orig_text:
き、
気の持ちよう……
ということでしょうか？
とにかく、
一心不乱にがんばるしかなさそうですね……！
